launch_identity: GITHUB_SHA/tree and actual workflow SHA-256 recorded before metadata collection; observed Actions image/resources recorded, label alone insufficient
source_pins: input-resolution.json; known primary identities do not close unknown bootstrap/build inputs
expectations: PROBE-PLAN.md; no arithmetic/ABI/dependency execution in this revision
enforcement: systemd cgroupv2, two-CPU cpuset, CPUQuota200%, MemoryMax6G, MemorySwapMax0; fixedext4 scratch; ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=read-only, ReadWritePaths=task, /dev/shm read-only; verify effective values and read-only rejection at /tmp, home, checkout and /dev/shm
cost_method: All attributable automatic jobs and attempts plus metadata workflow. AllocatedvCPU times elapsed job minutes is conservative proxy. Allocation job observes ubuntu-latest separately; no budget reset.
artifact_schema: launch-result.json, enforcement.json, confinement.json, installed-tools.json, installed-packages.tsv, group.log, scope.txt, sha256.json
stop_after: Metadata snapshot only; actual installed identity is an observation, not selection or permission to execute a build. Missing closure/configuration/probes and any enforcement failure leave image/ABI gates closed.
